evidence.quote: ACHIEVEMENT 13417 - Thine Princess Returned to Her Sire ... [CantStopTheRaj] This did not unlock with "Thou Hast Triumphed Together". Seems it triggers when receiving Gwaelin's Love.

subject: King
text: The King asks whether to save directly after the thank-you speech when Princess Gwaelin is returned.

evidence.quote: When you rescue the princess and take her to the king, directly after the "thank you" speech he will ask if you want to save your game.

subject: Saving at the King's prompt
object: Thine Princess Returned to Her Sire
text: Accidentally saving at the King's prompt after the thank-you speech prevents reloading to get the other princess achievements and forces a second playthrough.

evidence.quote: Highly recommend saving this achievement for last. ... It is very easy to accidentally hit "Yes" while scrolling the text, which will prevent you from reloading to a part where you can get the other princess achievements and require you to play through a second time if you save.

text: Leave Gwaelin in the cave, go get Erdrick's Sword from Charlock Castle, then save your game.

evidence.quote: the best thing to do is leave Gwaelin in the cave and go get Erdrick's Sword from Charlock Castle then save your game.

subject: Gwaelin route step 2
text: After the save, get Gwaelin, take her to the Dragonlord, beat him, and return to the king, which knocks out two of the achievements.

evidence.quote: From there go get Gwaelin take her to the Dragonlord beat him and return to the king that will knock out two of them.

subject: Gwaelin route step 3

evidence.quote: Then reset go beat the Dragonlord and don't save the princess.

subject: Gwaelin route step 4

subject: Multiple playthroughs

subject: In tow
text: In tow means Princess Gwaelin follows the player, not that she is in town.

evidence.quote: Warning “in tow” means Princess Gwaelin is accompanying and following you, it doesn’t mean in town

subject: Gwaelin alternate route
text: Go straight to the Dragonlord's castle without taking the princess, defeat him, then rescue the princess and take her to the King's castle.

evidence.translation: Go straight to the Dragonlord's castle without taking the princess, defeat him, only then rescue the princess and take her to the King's castle.
